overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Committee's late approval of two sets of minutes was excused as good cause, and the matter was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the School Committee failed to timely approve the minutes of its April 12 and May 10 meetings, which were approved September 13.
allegations.key_passage: we find the Committee has demonstrated good cause for its short delay in approving minutes for the April 12 and May 10 meetings.
